neighbours.label: words in biblical or Quranic narration: harvest, staff, Moses in scripture style (leak regime)
fire: And the Lord of the harvest sent forth laborers into the field.
Then Aaron cast down his staff before Pharaoh and his servants.
And Moses went up unto the mountain, and God spoke to him.
Behold, the harvest is great, but the laborers are few.
And he stretched out his staff over the waters of Egypt.
Thus We set forth parables for mankind, that they may reflect.
And God said unto Moses, I will execute judgement on the gods.
The sower went forth to sow, and the seed fell by the wayside.
quiet: The farm manager hired workers for the harvest in the field.
Then the hotel staff brought drinks to the guests and servants.
Then Mr Moses went up the mountain, and his guide spoke to him.
Look, the crop is large, but the workers are few.
And he held out his umbrella over the streets of Cairo.
We set out examples for customers, so that they may reflect.
And the judge told Mr Moses he would rule on the case.
The gardener went out to plant, and the seed fell by the fence.

notes: Card: mostly leak regime; ' harvest' 2, ' staff' 1, ' Moses' 1. Probes: Lord of the harvest 0.88, Aaron's staff 0.79; 'birds of the air' 0.02, 'except Moses' 0.09, modern harvest 0.05, office staff 0.01. Uneven, so scripture style may not be what carries it.
